notes.title: First Major Update for "Fairy Spirit Chronicles" - It's Explosive!
notes.content:
Update Patch 20250523

New Tower Climb Mode
In Tower Climb Mode, you must challenge each level sequentially from the first to the last, with no unexpected interruptions.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549523/4c339bd6455c92f71cc9c2ebcbff1620c0a2545f.jpg

New Challenge Mode
In Challenge Mode, the difficulty increases progressively with each level. Can you conquer them all?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549523/615150d693acadc35f129514b5a28b14fdc8b9ef.jpg

Reset for Normal, Step, and Time Limit Modes
All modes have been reset with completely revamped, beautifully adjusted artwork. Each mode now features 21 stunning images in varying styles. If unsatisfied, feel free to leave comments for potential replacements.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549523/fb72d34386faa4b94daa83e6cad68417bcceba79.jpg

New Steam Achievements
Added new Steam achievements, bringing the total count to 22.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549523/05f23fc529c1dc3a4ec94eaf9ac81e949b660134.jpg

Three New BGM Tracks
Added three new background music tracks: "Light Melody," "Serene Tune," and "Joyful Rhythm."
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549523/5539ebf223eb160a139aeeaf37b8cb0c707d2336.jpg

Gallery Mode Reset
Gallery Mode has been expanded to five volumes, with each volume now corresponding to different game modes.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549523/054beb3e5ecf3e1a92923e797f08a07733c41469.jpg

Other Minor Adjustments
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549523/77bfc10fa61bcb1491b28551e565d915a8bbab5a.jpg
